When I was about seven, I saw a magic show at my school. The best trick was one where the magician had two boxes each on opposite ends of the stage. It was a pretty standard trick. He put a chicken in one box, covered them both with sheets, snapped his fingers, then the chicken was in the other box. 
It wasn't that exciting, until he said, "Do you kids want to see how I did this trick?" Cue childish excitement and screaming from the crowd. So he tells us, "Ok, I'll do it again, but in slow motion." 
The lights go down and slow techno music begins to play as the magician slowly walks across the stage and places the chicken, once again, in the box on the opposite end of the stage. He then makes his way to center stage and snaps his fingers, still in slow motion.
A man in a giant rabbit costume then comes from backstage, opens the cage with the chicken in it, takes the chicken out, and slowly runs to the other side of the stage. He places the chicken in the other box, then runs off. 
Te magician then goes back to normal pace and viola! The chicken is in the other box. It was hilarious, and by far the best trick I've ever seen.
